description: A supplied actual public certificate of \(\mathrm{HA}^{\mathrm C},\Gamma\vdash_X A\) transforms into an actual public certificate of \(\mathrm{HA},\Gamma^{\mathsf N}\vdash_X A^{\mathsf N}\). The original free-name set is identical and the output has finite support in the original HA axioms together with precisely the translated additional assumptions.
